meta.title: fix: memory leaks and server stability issues
meta.body_summary: Address critical memory leaks and stability issues in the MCP server: add bounded token cache in GeminiModelProvider, fix cleanup thread shutdown race conditions, and improve error logging.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code fixed memory leaks in MCP server; maintainer guidedways flagged cache limits clashing with MCP_PROMPT_SIZE_LIMIT; PR open, no merge decision.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 141 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small targeted fix by absolute volume. It fits a focused server-stability performance PR that is still open pending review resolution; maintainer feedback addressed cache configuration constraints.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer guidedways noted that the 10KB text size limit clashes with MCP_PROMPT_SIZE_LIMIT, and the 100 cache entries may not suffice for long-running overnight conversations; gemini-code-assist bot suggested environment variable configuration and specific exception types.
review_details.performance_claim: Bounded token cache and improved thread shutdown prevent memory leaks and server crashes.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Server memory management and thread safety are within Agent scope, but the fixing of cache limits requires alignment with other server configuration values that the Agent did not anticipate (MCP_PROMPT_SIZE_LIMIT).

detection_detail.code_reading: guidedways manually reviewed the cache limits and identified conflict with MCP_PROMPT_SIZE_LIMIT; gemini-code-assist bot flagged exception handling and configuration suggestions.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR claims all unit tests pass but no before/after memory profiling; cache limits are tuned but no benchmark evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR still open; no regression handling required.

core_change_summary.description: In providers/gemini.py, added bounded LRU-style token cache with cleanup when entries exceed 100, max text length 10000, and cache statistics tracking; in utils/storage_backend.py, improved cleanup thread shutdown with smaller sleep intervals, better logging, and increased join timeout; in server.py, replaced silent except: pass with warning logs for activity logging errors, and added background cache monitoring task.
change_trajectory: Single commit implementing cache bounds, thread shutdown improvements, and error logging; no subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Gemini Code Assist provided an automated summary and code review highlighting the PR changes.
Suggested making cache max entries and text length configurable via environment variables.
Suggested using OrderedDict for clarity in LRU cache implementation.
Suggested catching OSError instead of bare except in error logging.
Suggested logging stack trace if cleanup thread fails to shutdown gracefully.
Noted that 10,000 characters cache text limit clashes with MCP_PROMPT_SIZE_LIMIT and must match.
Noted that 100 cache entries may be insufficient for long-running overnight conversations.

collaboration_trajectory: Claude Code authored PR with single commit fixing memory leaks and adding monitoring.
Gemini Code Assist bot provided automated review with suggestions on configuration and exception handling within minutes.
Maintainer guidedways reviewed inline comments, highlighting cache size limits conflict with existing MCP_PROMPT_SIZE_LIMIT and insufficient cache entries for long-running sessions.
PR remains open with no further commits or merge decision.
